name: receive_goods
title: Receive goods
description: Record goods received (GRN) against a RELEASED purchase order: stock goes up, and the order closes once everything has arrived. Cannot receive more than was ordered.

po_no.description: the released order the goods came against

warehouse.description: optional; defaults to the order's warehouse

confirm.description: false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

policy.on_lost_write_reply: never resent blindly: look the document up (by its key or by what changed) and return it
policy.on_busy_before_write: ok=false with next_step; nothing was saved, so the same call is safe to repeat

release_notes.1.1: 3 Nov 2026 (Lecture 4 production-grade pass): a lost grn_save reply is looked up (the new GRN for this order and quantity) instead of coming back as TIMEOUT, so a retry no longer posts a second goods receipt; quantity must be more than 0.
